objective: Deploy the exact product-approved Error Intelligence candidate to the existing public hosted KEP Devnet service while preserving PostgreSQL state and forbidding protocol transactions.

deployment_substrate.posture: Dockerfile and Compose bytes are unchanged; the application image and product epoch are new and bound below.

exact_remote_material.environment_transformation: Replace only the exact KEP_IMAGE line in current mode-0600 .env; do not output or alter any other value.

recovery_material.dump_requirement: fresh nonempty PostgreSQL custom-format dump created before activation
recovery_material.rollback_posture: Preserve only. Any rollback requires a separate exact authorization.

database_effect.effect: Application startup executes additive, idempotent ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS statements against the existing kep_hosted.client_error_journal.
database_effect.forbidden: No restore, row deletion, table drop, volume replacement, database-container recreation, credential change, or destructive migration.

allowed_effects_in_order: revalidate the exact current-state guard, required path absence, public old root, and local archive digest and size; stop before effects on mismatch
create the exact fresh mode-0600 predeployment PostgreSQL dump and verify it is nonempty
upload the exact image archive once to its exact .next path and verify remote digest and size
load the archive once, require the exact image tag, and require the remote semantic projection to match d5228f48 while recording the engine-local image ID
copy active compose.yaml and mode-0600 .env to the exact rollback paths
derive the exact mode-0600 next environment by replacing only KEP_IMAGE, verify expected digest 371c6994, and atomically promote it to .env without changing compose.yaml
run docker compose up -d --no-build once for the existing project
perform bounded application health, unchanged database-container ID, preserved volume, migration-column, public HTTPS, exact-root-byte, TLS, and Solana-Devnet identity reads
stop_conditions: any pre-effect guard or archive mismatch
any dump, upload, image-load, semantic-projection, rollback-copy, environment, activation, migration, health, database-identity, volume, HTTPS, TLS, network, or root-byte failure
execution_envelope.retry_policy: none; stop and report exact residue after the first failed or ambiguous effect
forbidden_effects: Mainnet, paid RPC fallback, protocol transaction, signature request, wallet use, or SOL transfer
printing, exporting, replacing, or reusing any credential or secret environment value
database restore, row deletion, table drop, volume removal, database-container recreation, image pruning, or destructive migration
mutation of unrelated VPS containers, networks, volumes, routes, files, or services
automatic retry or rollback after a failed or ambiguous effect
publication, release, Git commit, Git push, or source substitution

risk_disclosure.availability: The application container will be replaced. A post-activation failure may leave the public service unavailable until separately authorized rollback.
risk_disclosure.database: Migration 002 is additive and passed disposable PostgreSQL tests, but it will mutate the existing schema. A fresh same-VPS dump is required first.
risk_disclosure.backup: This envelope creates only a same-VPS dump; it does not prove off-host backup or restore verification.
risk_disclosure.transaction: No Solana transaction or wallet signature is permitted.

claim_limit: Deployment candidate only. It does not authorize itself, SSH write, dump creation, upload, image load, schema migration, container replacement, rollback, retry, publication, release, or any other external effect.
